answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a scarce, independently issued credential in a vault before it can post bids or earn reputation. The registry checks that the credential is unique, while a harbor of established agents can vouch for renewals only after observing completed trades. This does not make Sybils impossible, but multiplying accounts now requires acquiring more real credentials and tying up capital in each bond; cheating can forfeit the bond and drive the attacker’s reputation to its nadir.
